title: A Survey of Flaky Tests
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)

exact_flaky_definition.quote: Tests that fail inconsistently, without changes to the code under test, are described as flaky.

finite_reruns_rationale: Finite reruns passively explore the execution space and cannot prove determinism. As S040 documents, elusive flaky tests depend on rare thread interleavings or environments (p. 17:59), exhibit consecutive burst lengths (p. 17:33), and remain detectable even after up to 10,000 reruns (p. 17:39). Observing N>=3 matching controls establishes consistency within the sample, but never cures flakiness or proves determinism.
